label: Most a deposit can be (annual rent £50,000 to £100,000)
context: The higher cap applies to tenancies in England with an annual rent from £50,000 up to £100,000. The Tenant Fees Act does not cover tenancies with a higher rent.
A tenancy with an annual rent of this or more, up to £100,000, can have a deposit of up to 6 weeks' rent.

label: Most a court can order a landlord to repay the tenants, as a multiple of the deposit
